Use Codex or Claude Code to explore a Magento checkout without opening an IDE. Ask which modules depend on `Magento_Catalog`, trace a dependency injection declaration, or find out whether a change calls for `setup:upgrade`. The headless alpha also checks individual XML files. PHP semantic analysis, upgrade compatibility scanning, and scaffolding still require the desktop plugin.

### Set up Codex

From the root of a Magento checkout with Composer dependencies installed, run:

```bash
installer=$(mktemp) && curl -fLsS 'https://github.com/magento/magento2-phpstorm-plugin/releases/download/2026.3.7-alpha-2/magento-hce.pyz' -o "$installer" && python3 "$installer" setup --client codex
```

For Claude Code, replace `--client codex` with `--client claude`. Setup installs the engine and plugin, indexes the checkout, verifies a module lookup, and registers the MCP server for the selected client.

Supported hosts are Linux x86-64 and Apple Silicon macOS with Python 3.12+ and curl. On first use, review the JetBrains runtime agreement and sign in if prompted. The pinned engine requires a valid IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate subscription or an active JetBrains trial.

The installer gets the headless build from the same [JetBrains Marketplace listing](https://plugins.jetbrains.com/plugin/8024-magento-2-and-adobe-commerce) as the desktop plugin. [Headless setup guide](https://github.com/magento/magento2-phpstorm-plugin/blob/2026.3.7-alpha-2/modules/hce/README.md#install-on-a-development-host)
